keyDates.text: Federal FAFSA deadline for 2025-2026 academic year. Also: last day to originate Grad PLUS loans under current rules before July 1 elimination.
Grad PLUS loan program eliminated for new borrowers. SAVE plan replaced by Repayment Assistance Plan (RAP). Parent PLUS capped at $20K/year.
Deadline for current borrowers to enroll in existing income-driven repayment plans (IBR, PAYE, SAVE) before automatic transfer to RAP.
DHS Duration of Status (D/S) elimination rule expected to take effect for new F, J, and I visa holders, capping most international students at 4 years.
OBBBA tiered endowment tax goes into effect for private universities. Harvard faces ~$368M bill; Yale ~$276M; Princeton ~$217M; Stanford ~$202M.
Harvard's response due in U.S. District Court (Judge Richard Stearns) to DOJ's March 2026 Title VI antisemitism lawsuit seeking grant clawback.
Columbia EEOC antisemitism $21M claims process expected to close. Columbia agreed to $221M total settlement with Trump administration in July 2025.
First Circuit oral arguments expected on Trump administration's appeal seeking to reinstate $2.7B Harvard research funding freeze.

charts.title: Federal Settlements with Ivy/Peer Schools: Amounts Paid to Trump Administration
charts.footnote: Columbia paid $200M to federal government plus $21M to EEOC ($221M total). Brown paid $50M in Rhode Island workforce grants over 10 years. Cornell paid $30M over 3 years. Harvard deal proposed at $500M-$1B; no agreement reached as of June 2026.
